text:
emily: Heads-up  Launch webinar 'Benchmarking Inference' scheduled Thu May 4, 10am PT. Need ops checklist for reg page, Zoom config, recording redundancy, and post-event asset flow. Can we split owners?
dan: I'll take the registration page + GA/UTM tagging. Plan: short hero, 2 bullets (what you'll learn), and a single CTA 'Save my seat'. Add hidden field utm_source=launch-email.
jess: I can own emails: confirmation, 24h reminder, 15m reminder, and replay send. Question: do we attach slides in the replay or link to gated download?
emily: Gated for 72h then public. Immediate replay email will say "Recording processing  will deliver full replay + slides in 72 hours". Keep subject lines punchy.
marco: Zoom/recording ops: set meeting to auto-record to cloud + enable live transcript (host must toggle during meeting). I'll also run OBS on a backup laptop recording to local drive (MKV) for archiving.
ops-bot: notice: cloud recording retention default 30 days; change request must go through ops if longer.
dan: Form fields to capture: email, first/last name, company, role, phone (optional), marketing_consent checkbox. Map to Marketo lead fields.
jess: Email subject ideas: "You're registered: Benchmarking Inference" or "See you at Benchmarking Inference". I'll A/B test the shorter subject for paid ads.
emily: Promo plan: organic posts + 2 paid cohorts (SaaS engineers, infra leads). sam? (not in thread) will run paid. Dan, share landing URL when live.
marco: Technical checklist: assign co-hosts (emily + marco), mute participants on entry, disable waiting room, enable Q&A panel, enable polls. Set alternative host as backup.
jess: Post-event flow: 1) Raw recording to Drive, 2) Edit highlights (2 mins x 3), 3) 72h replay + gated slides, 4) 7-day nurture email with CTAs. Who edits clips?
emily: @marco can export rough cuts, but volunteers for final trim? I'll ask creative for 30s social cuts.
marco: I'll upload raw + SRT captions to Drive in folder /marketing/webinars/benchmark-inference/raw within 2 hours after event. Notify jess & dan.
ods-bot: reminder: enable "Allow live transcript" during meeting to generate VTT/SRT.
dan: Lead routing: mark a lead as MQL if role contains "engineer" OR company employee_count > 50 OR engaged with email > 2x. MQLs -> SDR-Pipeline, else -> nurture. I'll add Marketo smart list after page goes live.
jess: Also include checkbox opt-in for follow-up content and product updates. Must be explicit per GDPR.
emily: Rehearsal: Tue 15 min dry-run with presenters, 10 min mic + deck pass. Everyone on the thread must join.
marco: Presenters should use wired network and headset. Avoid Wi-Fi if possible.
emily: OK, summary: dan (landing + tagging), marco (Zoom + recordings), jess (emails + replay), emily (promo + rehearsal). We'll sync Tue after rehearsal. Post landing link when live. :rocket:
